identity_verification: All four supplied case sidecars identify round 1, run a1baf3fe3dc2, and the expected binary and source SHA-256 values. Get-FileHash SHA256 was applied to every original candidate and reference PNG; all eight hashes match the respective case-sidecar evidence. The expected reference-set identity was supplied by the coordinator; this batch independently checked its four individual reference PNG hashes.
comparison_basis: Original candidate PNGs are 930 x 1240 at logical scale 1. Reference PNGs are 1860 x 2480 at physical scale 2. Visual geometry was compared in the same 930 x 1240 logical coordinate system. All eight original files were individually opened with tools.view_image; no transformed PNG was substituted as evidence.

Brightness and warmth each have a visible value, minus button, track, thumb, and plus button. Candidate values 12 and 8 match the case-sidecar preferences; their thumb positions remain consistent with a 0..24 range. All slider controls fit inside the content width without clipping.
The section title, body labels, serif numeric values, white surface, thin gray boundaries, and monochrome icons preserve the reference hierarchy. No shadow or stippled page background was observed.

Every visible navigation entry and all five dock destinations fit inside the viewport. The device capability summary is ellipsized within its header area and does not overlap the right-hand status column.
No ambient-light sensor capability is established by the supplied desktop sidecar. Absence of the reference auto-brightness control is therefore not treated as a visual defect.

The complete visible navigation confirms that there is no pen entry between frontlight and power. No fake pen or palm-rejection switches are shown. This satisfies the explicit capability-bound capture requirement.

suggestions.description: The applicable logging section exposes only unavailable controls and omits the visible operation status.
suggestions.evidence: The candidate log-file toggle, export action, and clear action all use disabled gray styling. The sidecar settings_status records an unavailable state, while the screenshot contains no visible explanation. The reference has an enabled log toggle and reachable export and clear buttons. This case has no logging capability bound or intentional exception.
suggestions.recommendation: Connect log writing, export, and clear to actual logging operations and keep supported actions reachable. Render the real operation result or unavailable reason in the section so the user can understand the current state; do not enable placeholder actions.

suggestions.description: Required update, Wi-Fi, and screensaver policies remain unavailable in the power section.
suggestions.evidence: The candidate charging-update and reading-time Wi-Fi switches are disabled. The current-cover, reading-progress, and system-default screensaver cards are all disabled and have no selected state; an unavailable label is shown. The reference exposes these policies and a selected screensaver. The case metadata declares no capability bound or intentional exception for these controls.
suggestions.recommendation: Implement the actual supported charging-update, Wi-Fi, and screensaver policy operations, persist their settings, and reflect the real current selection. Keep the existing reachable keep-awake and exit actions. Any genuine target limitation should have explicit capability evidence and a visible explanation rather than unconditional disabled placeholders.

suggestions.description: The logging action buttons are narrower than the normalized reference buttons.
suggestions.evidence: At candidate scale 1, export spans approximately x=356..456 and clear spans x=468..568, giving about 100 logical pixels per button. The reference buttons span approximately x=356..474 and x=486..604 after physical-scale-2 normalization, giving about 118 logical pixels per button. The discrepancy remains independent of the enabled or disabled state.
suggestions.recommendation: Restore the reference horizontal button padding or minimum width, approximately 118 logical pixels for these labels, while retaining the existing left alignment and inter-button gap.

limitations: This independent review covers only the four assigned cases and eight PNGs in reference-28; it does not declare the entire round clean.

Only existing JSON and PNG evidence was read, PNG hashes were computed with Get-FileHash, and the requested review JSON was written. No application, build, test suite, runtime probe, Git operation, or product modification was performed.
Static captures and supplied sidecars establish the displayed state, not successful execution of logging, hardware, or power operations. Runtime behavior was not verified.

Geometry values are approximate manual observations in normalized logical coordinates. Reference display resizing by the image viewer was accounted for; no pixel-difference analysis or transformed evidence image was used.
The desktop profile exposes implemented frontlight and warmth controls but does not qualify physical hardware. Sensor and pen differences were evaluated within the explicit capability bounds.
